sentences.en: People are not so honest as they once were.
sentences.zh: 人们不再像以前那样诚实了。

chunks.x: so honest as they once were

sentences.en: The temptation to steal is greater than ever before especially in large shops.
sentences.zh: 偷窃的诱惑力比以往任何时候都大，尤其是在大商店里。

sentences.en: A detective recently watched a well-dressed woman who always went into a large store on Monday mornings.
sentences.zh: 最近一名侦探监视了一个穿着讲究的女人，她总是在星期一上午进一家大商场。

sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: there were fewer people in the shop than usual when the woman came in,
sentences.zh: 当这个女人走进商场时，里面的人比往常少，

sentences.en: so it was easier for the detective to watch her.
sentences.zh: 所以侦探更容易监视她。

chunks.x: for the detective to watch her

sentences.en: The woman first bought a few small articles.
sentences.zh: 女人先买了几样小东西。

sentences.en: After a little time, she chose one of the most expensive dresses in the shop
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，她挑了店里最贵的一件连衣裙

chunks.x: of the most expensive dresses in the shop

sentences.en: and handed it to an assistant who wrapped it up for her as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 把它递给售货员，售货员以最快的速度为她包好。

chunks.x: to an assistant who wrapped it up for her as quickly as possible

sentences.en: Then the woman simply took the parcel and walked out of the shop without paying.
sentences.zh: 然后女人拿上包裹，没付钱就走出了商场。

sentences.en: the detective found out that the shop assistant was her daughter.
sentences.zh: 侦探发现那个售货员是她的女儿。

chunks.x: that the shop assistant was her daughter

sentences.en: The girl 'gave' her mother a free dress once a week!
sentences.zh: 这个姑娘每周“送”给母亲一件免费的连衣裙！
